scientific.integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by a complete face-poset enumeration and an explicit acyclic matching, with an independent mod-2 cellular-homology check.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns only the regular cyclic tournament on nine vertices; no family theorem, equivariant homotopy classification, or general chromatic obstruction is claimed.

title: The directed Hom complex \(\operatorname{Hom}(\overrightarrow{C}_3,R_9)\) has the homotopy type of a circle
